rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to say that someone has become tanned or darker from the sun.

example.english: I went to the beach for a few days and got tanned all over.
example.traditional: 我去咗沙灘幾日，成個人都曬黑咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 saa1 taan1 gei2 jat6 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 saai3 hak1 zo2

rows.note: Use this for a notably dark complexion, especially when the exact cause or recentness of the suntan is not important.

example.english: His tanned complexion makes him look really cool when he smiles.
example.traditional: 佢皮膚黝黑，笑起上嚟好有型。
example.jyutping: keoi5 pei4 fu1 jau2 hak1 siu3 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 jau5 jing4

rows.note: Use this for a bronze-coloured suntan rather than simply saying that the skin has become darker.

example.english: They are tanned to a bronze colour and look great in a swimsuit.
example.traditional: 佢曬成古銅色，着泳衣幾好睇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 saai3 sing4 gu2 tung4 sik1 zoek6 wing6 ji1 gei2 hou2 tai2
